en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5609 - It is narrated by Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Zurara from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) regarding a man who passed away and left behind his daughter and his full sister (sister from his father and mother).
Imam (as) said: "The wealth belongs to the daughter, and the full sister has no share in it."
